question: Calcium hypochlorite is commonly known as ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**bleaching powder**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Calcium hypochlorite is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula Ca(OCl)2.
 
• It is commonly referred to as bleaching powder or calcium oxychloride.
 
• It is produced industrially by treating lime (Ca(OH)2) with chlorine gas.
 
• It is very stable and can be stored for an extended period of time.
 
• This compound is the main ingredient of commercial products such as bleaching powder, chlorine powder and chlorinated lime which are used for water treatment and as a bleaching agent.
 
• It is also used in the sanitization of public swimming pools and to disinfect drinking water.
